_doc: San Diego's chain as data for tools/ship_track.sh (V3-PLAN P1, Lariat plan). tools/ship_sd.sh stays the chain of record (not a shim); this file reproduces its step sequence, re-synced 2026-10-13 to ship_sd.sh after ledger 0046 and v0.18.0 (0052: the race gate OBJ extracted before the AI writer + verify_ai_line; 0050: verify_fold_fans after the race gates; 0046 integration fix round: deck_datum first, ground_release after the triangulation, the I-8 pavement inside prep_prep before the split; 2026-10-26 ledger 0054 P4: the rock faces inside prep_prep after the I-8 pavement, the building caches and the sandstone tile synced in) (tiered terrain: terrain_sample / terrain_resample around the trim, triangulate_terrain after the seat, slim_far_terrain retired, the road gate OBJ before the track folder, the 3DEP cache + I-8 corridor synced in and out); tests/tools/test_ship_track_chain.py diffs the step headers. The assembler runs from tracks/san-diego-lake-murray/scripts-v021 through V021_SHIM, as in ship_sd.sh. engine-july runs the prep / exporter / spawn builder for this track only (tools/ship_track.sh decides that from the track name; ENG=<dir> points it at a scratch copy, as in ship_sd.sh; no key here can). 2026-11-03, ledger 0065 (v4 is Lake Murray's line): this file is v4's chain of record (tools/ship_sd.sh stays the 0.19.x chain: v4 = its steps + the terrain thin, the red repairs, the street-only kn5, the bespoke blocks and the house gate); draft 'bespoke' stands the buildings pipeline's blocks where ship_sd.sh's SD_BESPOKE=1 rehearsal did, gate 'houses' holds the built road kn5 to v4's 7,600 blocks, sync_in.assets brings the house textures engine-july lacks, and every prep input that lived only in the workshop (red_repairs.plan.json, terrain.tiers.json.gz, terrain.refine.json.gz, bridges.cache.json) and the draft's caches now cross both ways.

sync_in._optional_doc: 2026-11-03 (ledger 0065, the PC's coverage trace of v4): red_repairs.plan.json (tools/red_repairs.py, read by the prep's red repairs), terrain.tiers.json.gz (the thin step, rib_check, the assembler), terrain.refine.json.gz (the prep's RefineField, ground_release_blend) and bridges.cache.json (the prep's bridge spans, author_bridges, bridge_level) lived only in the workshop; scatter_positions.json (the draft's palm / tree / scrub / median-planting positions, read by make_treefx and the race_verify scenery gate: without it v4's 21,111 TreeFX trees are 17,728, the PC's 0.20.1 run) the same; network.cache.json, road_lanes.cache.json, osm.expansion.json, expansion.north.samples.json.gz are the draft's caches; source/bespoke/buildings.json is the planned blocks
sync_in._seed_doc: ledger 0099 (Lake Murray from an EMPTY workshop; ledger 0090 'Open'): copied into the project only where it has no file yet, never over a workshop's own (tools/ship_track.sh). The rule: every sync_out file airoso holds that sync_in does not already bring, so a fresh workshop starts as the last synced-back one left it. loop.blend is the blend the last install synced back (0.20.4's, 2026-11-23: sha256 495a2198..., 189,120,404 B; 0.20.2's was 3f13b887..., 189,063,384 B; every author step on it is idempotent, ledger 0099; LFS: an un-pulled pointer is refused); the draft's data the --skip-blend steps read (connectors, mouths, pads, stubs, median bands, centrelines, ground release, deck datum, lights, bespoke report...) and the run's own records, which the run rewrites. data/centerline.geojson (scripts/ac/track_folder.py: the lap length) and data/centerline.elevation.json (scripts/geometry/drive_test.py: the replication rows) were read by the chain but crossed neither way; they are now in sync_out and seeded. The north laps' own records (lap.north.json, barrier_bands.north.json, dummies_north_*.json, ...) were absent until 0.20.4's install synced them back (0.20.2 was built in a scratch workshop that never did); with walk_grade.json, walk_grade.seat.json and lights.heads.json they are seeds now by the same rule (23 files, 2026-11-23); the author / ship / gate steps rewrite every one of them
sync_in._optional_median_doc: ledger 0099: source/vegetation/median_heights.lidar.json is scenery.treefx.median_measured.file (2026-11-19, Kevin: 'B: lidar height each'); tools/make_treefx.py reads it from the project, and no list carried it, so every rebuild since that config change would stop at the TreeFX step

_workshop_doc: ledger 0099: the chain's own workshop is lm_line, which the chain creates empty and fills from airoso (sync_in + seed). lm_v4 holds v4's own 0.20.1 blend and data and lm_phase2/project 0.20.2's scratch build: both are kept as records and neither is the line any more (a seed never overwrites, so a run on lm_v4 would have built from v4's blend)
